title: Pricing
description: Choose the level of homework support your family needs, from guided practice to professional teacher support.
supportLevelBody: Guided practice, parent reports, and professional teacher support stay connected in one family learning path.
valueBody: STOA combines guided homework support, parent-visible learning signals, and teacher support escalation so students can get unstuck while families stay informed.
checkoutBody: Plan selection is being prepared. Please contact STOA to continue with a plan.
pilotBody: Start with a free trial, see whether STOA fits your family routine, then choose a plan when ready.
pilotDetail: Each plan makes the student, parent, and teacher support level clear before checkout.
faqPaymentBody: Checkout currently shows the plan choice flow without charging a card. Live payment collection will use a secure hosted payment page.

faqs.question: Is payment live now?
faqs.answer: Checkout currently shows the plan choice flow without charging a card. Live payment collection will use a secure hosted payment page.

faqs.question: Can parents test before paying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Families can start with the free trial, see how STOA fits homework routines, and choose a paid plan later.

faqs.question: What happens when a plan limit is reached?
faqs.answer: STOA shows a clear upgrade or renewal path before support is interrupted.
